title: Price Substantiation Extension
description: Carries the reference price and period behind a variant's list_price comparison claim. Vendor-namespaced (com.aaronbatchelder.price_substantiation) incubation of a proposed dev.ucp.shopping.price_substantiation extension. Response-only; purely additive.

list_price_basis.title: List Price Basis
list_price_basis.description: Substantiation for `list_price`. Present only when the Business asserts a basis for the comparison. Absence carries no meaning.

basis.description: What the list price refers to. Well-known values: `prior_price` (a price this Business actually charged for this variant), `msrp` (manufacturer's or supplier's suggested price). Businesses MAY use additional values.

reference_price.description: The price the reduction is measured against. For `prior_price` in jurisdictions with a lowest-prior-price rule (e.g. EU Price Indication Directive Art. 6a), this is the lowest price applied during `period`, which MAY differ from `list_price`.

start.description: First day of the reference period (ISO 8601 date).

end.description: Last day of the reference period (ISO 8601 date).

source.description: Attesting party when `basis` is not the Business itself (e.g. manufacturer name for `msrp`).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.title: Catalog Search with Price Substantiation
dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog Search response whose product variants MAY carry list_price_basis.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.title: Catalog Lookup with Price Substantiation
dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog Lookup responses whose variants MAY carry list_price_basis.
